risk_note: RV2 by path (union). Implements Taobao's official search taobao.tbk.dg.material.optional.upgrade (permission 27939, D10-582); until now searchItems threw adapter_unimplemented outside dataoke. Whole rows go through mapTaobaoDetail, so three prices, commission and promotion windows match the detail path. A price that fails stays as price_status=anomaly for catalog's PRICE_ANOMALY; only a missing title, an invalid commission or an unconvertible id skips the row, under its own event, and an all-skipped page raises invalid_dto. Search ids match the detail id only on the last segment (5 of 5 measured), so they go through item.info.upgrade.get and match by last segment, for this path only: dataoke's positional match is unchanged. Conversion failures propagate; an empty result (empty map_data, total_results 0, 15/50001) is an empty page. A missing outer key is upstream_unavailable. adzone_id is the query scene active slot, BR-PROD-07. Staging stays on dataoke until this is verified there; the default TAOBAO_SEARCH_SOURCE is unchanged.
